resource.title: Physics II: Electricity and Magnetism (MIT 8.02, MIT OpenCourseWare)
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放（讲义、课堂活动、实验、习题与解答，无需注册）
resource.covers: 课程页提供的材料按 'Class Topics / Readings / Class Activities / Experiments / Problem Solving / Class Slides' 组织，覆盖静电（库仑、高斯、电势与电容）、电流与电阻、磁场与安培定律、电磁感应、麦克斯韦方程组与电磁波；超纲的矢势/相对论电动力学不在内。逐讲标题未逐条核对到每一项

courses.prereq_text: Prereq: Calculus I (GIR) and Physics I (GIR)
courses.scope_text: Introduction to electromagnetism and electrostatics: electric charge, Coulomb's law, electric structure of matter; conductors and dielectrics. Concepts of electrostatic field and potential, electrostatic energy. Electric currents, magnetic fields and Ampere's law. Magnetic materials. Time-varying fields and Faraday's law of induction. Basic electric circuits. Electromagnetic waves and Maxwell's equations.

courses.prereq_text: Prereq: Physics I (GIR); Coreq: Calculus II (GIR)
courses.scope_text: Parallel to 8.02, but more advanced mathematically. Some knowledge of vector calculus assumed. Maxwell's equations, in both differential and integral form. Electrostatic and magnetic vector potential. Properties of dielectrics and magnetic materials. In addition to the theoretical subject matter, several experiments in electricity and magnetism are performed by the students in the laboratory.

courses.course: PHYS 4C Physics for Physics Majors—Electricity and Magnetism
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: PHYS 4A-B or PHYS 2A-B-C, MATH 20A-B-C or 31BH, and 18 or 20F or 31AH.
courses.scope_text: Continuation of PHYS 4B covering charge and Coulomb's law, electric field, Gauss's law, electric potential, capacitors and dielectrics, current and resistance, magnetic field, Ampere's law, Faraday's law, inductance, AC circuits.
courses.hours_text: PHYS 4C. Physics for Physics Majors—Electricity and Magnetism (4)

notes: 候选判断依据：N.1.1 三门课都要求力学/Physics I（MIT 8.02、8.022 写 'Physics I (GIR)'，UCSD 4C 写 'PHYS 4A-B or PHYS 2A-B-C'）→ supported；M.1.3 见 MIT 8.022 'Coreq: Calculus II (GIR)' 与 UCSD 4C 'MATH 20A-B-C'（MATH 20B = 一元积分学）→ supported；M.1.4.1 见 UCSD 4C 的 MATH 20C（UCSD 目录原文：'Vector geometry, vector functions and their derivatives. Partial differentiation…'）→ supported；M.1.4.4（多元积分与向量分析，对应 MATH 20E）三门课都没有列，MIT 8.022 只写 'Some knowledge of vector calculus assumed'（属正文假设而非先修课名），故记 not_mentioned 而不是 recommended。MIT 8.02 现行目录只要求 Calculus I，18.02 的多元微积分要求出现在 OCW 旧版大纲之外的其他课（如 8.03）里，所以没有把 M.1.4.1 记成 MIT 8.02 的必修。
